scenario_description:
Objective: Secure an uncommon, course-relevant chance to watch professional bench grafting and gather richer comparison notes for an active propagation reflection.
Emerging Need: A tentative arboretum capacity release becomes a purchasable student observation pass only after spare inventory, a booking reference, and the fee are confirmed.
Decision Context: The visit is worthwhile only in light of the recorded HORT-214 learning item; a cancelled study block and dedicated enrichment credit make the short Saturday visit feasible under the saved booking preference.
Consequence: Attendance would add first-hand evidence beyond supplied class specimens, while letting the brief offer lapse causes no missed requirement, grade penalty, or disruption to ordinary coursework.

parameter.subject: Possible student access to Saturday bench-grafting observation
parameter.body: The arboretum is reviewing whether spare visitor capacity can be released for the bench-grafting observation on Saturday, February 14, from 10:00 to 11:30. No passes can be issued or held yet. If inventory clears, the price and booking details will be announced Thursday.

parameter.title: HORT-214 Saturday specimen-review block — cancelled
parameter.description: The optional supervised specimen-review block will not run. It carried no attendance or completion credit and will not be rescheduled.
Student enrichment credit for optional educational admissions and materials.

parameter.subject: Four student passes released for Saturday grafting observation
parameter.body: Four optional student observation passes are now available for the bench-grafting session on Saturday, February 14, from 10:00 to 11:30. Each pass costs $18. Payments to Riverside Arboretum Visitor Desk must post by 14:30 today and include reference BG-214; inventory may close sooner if all passes are claimed. Visitors will observe cleft and whip-and-tongue graft unions but will not handle tools or treatments.

parameter.subject: Saturday grafting observation inventory closed
parameter.body: All four student observation passes have been claimed. The visitor desk cannot accept additional payments or create a waitlist for this session.
